name: 3PM
source:
3PM follows the heartfelt adventures of Masi, Esper, and Lusa living their lives as students. Despite the ups and downs of life, whether they stand together or fall into ruin lies in your hands.

There are 5 unique endings, so consider your choices carefully.

[From [url=http://dezimaton.tumblr.com/day/2017/06/04/]Monsters & Girly Men[/url]]

A fanfiction visual novel game of Elsword focuses on three job paths of Add: Mastermind, Diabolic Esper, and Lunatic Psyker in an alternate universe.
translation:
《3PM》讲述了Masi、Esper和Lusa学生时期的真挚冒险经历。人生虽有风风雨雨，是挺身而出还是走向灭亡，都掌握在你的手中。

有5个独特的结局，所以请仔细考虑你的选择。

[来自[url=http://dezimaton.tumblr.com/day/2017/06/04/]怪物与少女男人[/url]]

《艾尔之光》是一款同人视觉小说游戏，聚焦于艾迪在平行宇宙中的三种职业路径：策划者、恶魔异能者和疯狂灵能者。
